title: Forensic Bounds and Identifiability Limits on the Origin of the Wow! Signal — reproducibility package
description: Manuscript sources, figures, analysis scripts, and extracted values for Shaad & Khan, 'The Wow! Signal: Exploring the Boundaries of Evidence and Inference' (submitted to the International Journal of Astrobiology). Regenerates every headline number and figure from frozen public inputs; see README.md reproduce steps. Excludes the private Hobart donor archive (raw data, thresholds, candidate lists).
